chapters.name: Reflection of Light at Curved Surfaces
chapters.overview: The image is formed at a distance of 30 cm from the mirror. They enlarge the image when the object is held close to the mirror (less than the focal length). A set of parallel rays are falling on a convex mirror.

chapters.name: Chemical Equations
chapters.overview: A chemical equation gives information about the reactants and products through their symbols and formulae. Note: Unbalanced chemical equation containing molecular formulae of the substances is known as skeleton equation. Though the equation (11) is balanced, the coefficients are not the smallest whole numbers.

chapters.name: Acids, Bases and Salts
chapters.overview: On dissolving bases in water produces hydroxide (OH-) ions. Acidic and basic solutions in water conduct electricity because they produce hydrogen ions and hydroxide ions respectively. Bases which are soluble in water are called alkalis.

chapters.name: Human Eye and Colourful World
chapters.overview: It is experimentally observed that the intensity of scattered light varies with angle of scattering. This is the basic process happens in scattering of light. Consequently, the refractive index of a medium depends on wavelength of light.

chapters.name: Classification of Elements - The Periodic Table
chapters.overview: Therefore, the first period contains only two elements. These elements show similar physical and chemical properties for example they are reactive metals. Mendeleeff’s Periodic law: The physical and chemical Properties of the elements are the periodic functions of their Atomic Masses.

chapters.name: Chemical Bonding
chapters.overview: Both the oxygen atoms have octet in the valence shell. Electrons in valence shell (valence electrons) are responsible for the formation of bonds between atoms. Each atom in the F2 molecule has an octet of valence electrons.

chapters.name: Electric Current
chapters.overview: Electric power is the product of potential difference and the current. This ordered motion of electrons is called electric current. Usually an ammeter is used to measure electric current.

chapters.name: Electromagnetism
chapters.overview: Magnetic field due to currents current flows through the circuit. We have seen that current carrying wires produce magnetic field. Note: This equation holds well only when direction of electric current is perpendicular to magnetic field.

chapters.name: Principles of Metallurgy
chapters.overview: The methods used for Extracting of Crude metal are Calcination, Roasting, Chemical reduction, Auto reduction, Displacement method, Electrolytic reduction . To make the process economical, electrolysis methods are to be adopted. Alloying is a method of improving the properties of a metal.

chapters.name: Carbon and Its Compounds
chapters.overview: Therefore, organic chemistry is totally allotted to carbon compounds. Like graphite, graphene is entirely composed of carbon atoms. The compounds containing only carbon and hydrogen in their molecules are called hydrocarbons.
